thesis: Look for AI-related demand in infrastructure services and existing workflows, while accounting for operating risk.
summary: A six-tier AI discussion spans energy, chips, data centers, models, enabling software and applications. Sanchez favors specialized physical services and real workflow cost reduction over generic chatbots, notes circular financing concerns, and warns that demos still need production engineering and retention of technical staff. She advocates using AI to improve existing businesses, recognizes correction overhead and uncertainty, and promotes an AI storefront sponsor and acquisition workshop.

insights.title: Search for supporting service demand
insights.explanation: She proposes maintenance and specialized facility services as exposure to AI spending without building a foundation model.

insights.title: A working demo is not a scaled service
insights.explanation: Payments, databases, APIs and failures require technical operation beyond quickly generating an interface.

insights.speaker: unresolved

insights.title: Start from an existing costly workflow
insights.explanation: Her application criterion is replacing a cost center or improving an actual process, rather than novelty alone.
insights.quote: don't be an idea guy be a workflow fixer

insights.title: Do not treat the market story as known
insights.explanation: She explicitly says even prominent builders do not know exactly what will happen.

review_status: Codex editorial draft; complete local transcript read; claims not independently verified
synthesis_method: Direct Codex extraction from complete local transcript; exact quotations verified locally
context_and_limits: Company values, spending, adoption, energy and macroeconomic shares are unverified. A 60% cost decrease is not automatically 60% more profit, and halved review time does not imply doubled income. Infrastructure niches require genuine expertise and appropriate operating standards; casual cleaning language understates this. Bubble and opportunity claims are speculative; sponsor offer is not an evaluated business.
review_changes: Adds demo-versus-production limits, technical retention, AI correction costs and explicit errors in converting efficiency into profit.
